dog.description_text:
Chief is a beautiful girl with a story that deserves a happy ending. She and feline friend, Pinto, were adopted together as kittens and spent the next four years in a loving home. Sadly, after the loss of their owner, Chief has found herself back at the shelter, wondering where her next chapter will take her.

After four years of knowing the comfort and security of a home, shelter life is a big change. Chief deserves another chance to feel safe, cherished, and loved. Her story may not have gone as planned, but there is still so much happiness waiting for her.
